summary: REQ-6 appears implemented: ContactSection now reads business contact details from a frontend config module, renders phone/email as clickable tel:/mailto: links, renders address as plain text unless an addressLink is provided, and hides any unconfigured fields (no more "TBD").

hallucinated_features.description: Inquiry form now triggers a client-side alert and logs to console on submit (beyond just rendering UI).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only required updating contact details rendering; it explicitly allowed the form to remain UI-only but did not request new submit behavior/notifications.
